description: This file defines classes, functions, and logic for loading and using a machine learning model (specifically ONNX-based) to predict rainfall and flood probability based on recent sequences of climate data. It includes data class definitions, model loading, feature matrix construction, and prediction functions.

classes.name: ModelAMeta
classes.description: Stores metadata parameters for the model, such as sequence length, features, flood threshold, and optional ONNX input name.

classes.name: ModelAArtifacts
classes.description: Holds the model’s artifacts including provider info, metadata, scalers, and the ONNX model instance.

methods.name: ModelAArtifacts load_model_a_onnx( onnx_path: str, meta_path: str, scaler_x_path: str, scaler_y_path: str, )
methods.description: Loads the ModelA artifacts from file paths, including meta, scalers, and ONNX model.

methods.name: tuple[float,float] month_to_cyc(month: int)
methods.description: Converts month number to its sine and cosine cyclical representation.

methods.name: np.ndarray build_feature_matrix(sequence: list[dict[str, float]], feature_names: list[str])
methods.description: Constructs a feature matrix from a sequence of climate data dictionaries and feature names, including cyclical month features.

methods.name: dict[str,float] predict_next_rainfall_mm(art: ModelAArtifacts, sequence: list[dict[str, float]])
methods.description: Performs rainfall prediction based on the sequence data and the loaded model artifacts, returning predicted rainfall and flood probability.

ctags.name: build_feature_matrix
ctags.pattern: /^def build_feature_matrix(sequence: list[dict[str, float]], feature_names: list[str]) -> np.ndarr/

ctags.name: load_model_a_onnx
ctags.signature: ( onnx_path: str, meta_path: str, scaler_x_path: str, scaler_y_path: str, )

ctags.name: predict_next_rainfall_mm
ctags.pattern: /^def predict_next_rainfall_mm(art: ModelAArtifacts, sequence: list[dict[str, float]]) -> dict[str/
